Rasping Skeleton CR ½

Volcanic ash covers the landscape, at rest except when a gust of wind throws dust into the air. And then the surface layer roils, disturbed from below by a pile of bones the color of the ash, rising up to take on a human shape, bones making odd scraping sounds as they shift into their proper places.

XP 200
NE Medium undead
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +2
DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune cold, undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +2 (1d4+2)
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d4+3)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 14, Con —, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 10
Base Atk +0; CMB +2; CMD 14
Feats Improved Initiative B

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Rasping Grasp (Ex)

A rasping skeleton’s bones are partially fossilized, bonded with abrasive pumice. The skeleton adds +1 damage to any unarmed strike if its boney attack comes in contact with its opponent’s exposed skin (GM’s decision).

Rend (Ex)

If a rasping skeleton hits with two claw attacks in a round, it deliberately rubs its bones against the victim, rasping exposed skin and flesh from the victim.

ECOLOGY

Environment volcanic ash plain
Organization any
Treasure none
